seen.body: Owner requirement: the old identity must appear in no repository. Provide scripts/rewrite-identity.sh wrapping git-filter-repo: replace text in files and commit messages, authors and committers, across all refs, for a git repo or a colocated jj repo (re-init jj afterwards), with a dry-run report listing remaining occurrences. Scenario: a fixture repo with the old name in events, messages and author fields ends with zero occurrences and `qew check` still passes.
seen.title: Tool to rewrite an identity out of ledger and code repositories (history, events, commit messages)
